svg.aria-label: Trade-off radar chart comparing closed cloud APIs against self-hosted open-weights foundation models across 6 dimensions
svg.title: Open Weights vs. Closed APIs Trade-off Analysis
svg.text: CLOSED APIS VS. SELF-HOSTED OPEN WEIGHTS
Strategic, Architectural, and Economic Evaluation Framework

g.text: Closed Cloud APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google)
Advantages:
• Zero infrastructure maintenance (Serverless pay-per-token)
• Access to absolute frontier SOTA reasoning models
• Continuous automatic hardware upgrades
• Fast integration (1 line of Python code)
Drawbacks & Risks:
• Data privacy & regulatory hurdles in strict industries (HIPAA)
• Vendor lock-in and unexpected pricing changes
• Silent model updates altering output formatting
• Cost explodes at massive predictable scale (>10M req/day)
Self-Hosted Open Weights (LLaMA, Qwen, DeepSeek)
Advantages:
• 100% Data Sovereignty: Run in air-gapped on-premise VPCs
• Full weight modification: Custom fine-tuning & LoRA adapters
• Cost efficiency at high predictable volume (Fixed GPU cluster cost)
• Deterministic frozen weights with zero silent changes
Drawbacks & Risks:
• High upfront GPU reservation costs (NVIDIA H100 / A100)
• Requires dedicated MLOps team (vLLM, Kubernetes, autoscaling)
• Cold start latency during cluster scaling
• Open flagships (405B) require 8x H100 nodes to host
